title: The Vision of the Ram and the Goat
description: Daniel receives a prophetic vision by the Ulai River where a ram with two horns (representing Media and Persia) is defeated by a male goat with one large horn (representing Greece). The large horn breaks, four horns grow in its place, and from one of them arises a small horn that exalts itself against God and desecrates the sanctuary. The angel Gabriel explains that the vision concerns future kingdoms and a proud king who will destroy the holy people, before the sanctuary is finally restored.
